name: Surface Jacobian Covariance Stabilization
definition: Computes a floor for the layer-0 Gaussian covariance matrix based on the image-space Jacobian of the target surface, ensuring Gaussians are not smaller than the surface detail implied by the depth map.
summary: Surface Jacobian Covariance Stabilization ensures Gaussians match surface detail by computing a covariance floor from the image-space Jacobian of the target surface.
